name: Cafe Magistrat Rathaus Galerien
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Magistrat Rathaus Galerien in Innsbruck – a charming café nestled in the heart of Innsbruck’s historic Rathaus (Town Hall), where old-world elegance meets modern…
beschreibung: The Cafe Magistrat Rathaus Galerien in Innsbruck in the Innsbruck region offers its guests a warm atmosphere and a fine selection of coffee specialties and homemade delicacies. The café is renowned for its sunny terrace, which invites you to relax on warm days. The menu includes classic Austrian pastries, fragrant cakes, and tempting tortes, prepared fresh every day. Attentive service ensures that guests want for nothing. The Cafe Magistrat Rathaus Galerien is the ideal place for a relaxing coffee break amidst everyday Tyrolean life. Especially popular are the crispy pizzas baked in a wood-fired oven and topped with selected ingredients.
